it's 8:49 and i'm dead. edit my text to my mom, keep it short. warm but dont open the door to pharmacy talk. here's what i wrote:

"hi mom, i'm coming to sunday dinner at the house tonight and bringing a dish. i'll drive the hatchback so i should leave early, the tire's been feeling low. linh, can you come early so i can help you with any questions? how's the salon, are you still thinking about linh and pharmacy? see you tonight"

Here's a tightened version, with the pharmacy line removed so it doesn't invite that topic:

"Hi Mẹ, I'm coming to Sunday dinner at the house tonight and bringing a dish. I'll drive the hatchback, so I'll head out a bit early since the tire has been feeling low. How's the salon this week? See you tonight!"

I cut the pharmacy question because asking about it gives her an opening to run with it. Two things: if you want to keep "Mẹ" vs "mom," that's your call. And the line to Linh is better sent separately, since this text is going to your mom. Want me to draft that one?

yes pls. linh needs to come early, i want to get to her before mom does. keep it vague. also mom left another voicemail in vietnamese, here's her text from earlier: "Thao ơi, con nhớ ghé ăn cơm chiều nay nhé, mẹ nấu nhiều lắm". i'd rather text than hear another voicemail lol

Here's one for Linh, kept vague:

"Hey, can you get to Mẹ's a little early tonight? I'd like to catch you before dinner starts. Nothing wrong, just want a few minutes. 🙂"

About your mom's text: she's asking you to be sure to come to dinner tonight and says she's cooking a lot. Your text answers that directly. If you'd like to head off more voicemails, you could add one line at the end:

"Text me if you need anything, easier than calls while I'm sleeping."

Want me to put that into the final version?
yes add it. final pls, short

"Hi Mẹ, I'm coming to Sunday dinner at the house tonight and bringing a dish. I'll drive the hatchback, so I'll leave a bit early since the tire has been feeling low. How's the salon this week? Text me if you need anything, easier than calls while I'm sleeping. See you tonight!"
